items.title: Simple Spawns Megataiga
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A comfy town nestled amongst the tall trees of a boreal forest. The sound of cool, fresh water creeks running through the land gives this place a nostalgic and safe feeling.

- A quiet town suitable for a laid back comfy experience
- Lay back and enjoy the simple life.
- Share this experience with friends!

items.title: Farmers
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You are looking for tranquility, a secluded place. You need fresh air and you want to get back in touch with nature. Cultivate your beautiful lands on your own land by playing as one of the farmers available in this skin pack!

+ 2 free skins
+ 15 skins

items.title: TNT Engineers
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The tests don't seem to go very well... But it's not a big deal! Join the scientists and engineers studying explosives, the teenagers carrying all kinds of TNT and have fun throwing them between your friends! The games will be explosive! The TNT Engineers skin pack is for you!

+ 10 HD skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Pro Gamers
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens have been gaming for a long time, and are now pros! Watch out noobs, they know all the tricks to this game!

- 12 colorful skins!
- With a wide variety of outfits, you can find the perfect skin for you!

items.title: Simple Spawns Pirate Port
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
We sailing off to more frigid waters mateys! Tales speak of an abandoned island on the cold side of the sea. Many a pirate has tried to sale through the icy slush to reach whatever treasures are left to plunder, none have made it until now…

-An entire port to claim as your own.
-Explore the shipwrecks and discover treasures.
-Enjoy the adventure alone or with some mates!

items.title: Anime School
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
With their classic school uniforms in order, these anime teens are ready to hit the books... Tuck in that shirt!

- 8 different skins!
- A wide variety of school uniform designs!
- Bright and colorful characters, find one that suits you!

items.title: Hazmat Suits
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Oh no, there is a toxic spill in the lab! Quick, stay safe put on your safety gear! Hazmat suits protect against radiation and any other dangerous materials, essential for any lab!

- 8 different skins!
- Perfect for any mad scientists!

items.title: Life Roleplay
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
In life, you can be whatever you want to be, with this skin pack you can be a farmer, chef, or even an astronaut, have fun with your friends doing roleplay.

+11 skins
+1 free skin
+Perfect for roleplay
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Diamond Mobs
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
The playing field has evened! Mobs are now running around with solid diamond bodies! Can you block their attacks and survive their invasion or will you join them as one of the ranks of the diamond horde?

- Includes 5 diamond mob skins!

items.title: The Lost Land of Mythica
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Rediscover what's been lost with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Well beyond the recorded borders of the known world lies a forgotten civilization, long lost to the world. Tread carefully though, as dangerous foes await any who come to reclaim abandoned treasures or knowledge. Delve bravely, adventurer!

items.title: Molten Monsters
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
In this skin pack you'll find some cool and creative monster skins! These skins are perfect for traveling the Nether and fighting other monsters! Be careful and don't fall in the lava!

- 12 skins
- By: In collaboration with Twin B Studios

items.title: Gamer Squads
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Wanna match with the squad on your favorite servers? Gamer Squads has got you covered with 6 new HD skins designed specifically to improve your gameplay...or at least your fashion!

- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from MidnitePixel.

items.title: Realm of Fire
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Heat things up with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Delve deep into the fire scarred landscape as you search for a means of survival in hostile territory. Explore the charred city to uncover its treasures and claim this territory for yourself. Will you destroy what's left of the city? Or will you help it arise from the ashes?

items.title: Pirate Bay
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Weigh anchor and hoist the mizzen with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Ahoy, me hearties! Welcome to Pirate Bay, the perfect base of operations for a scallywag like yourself. Sure, it's been abandoned for awhile and could use some swabbing to bring it up to shipshape, but that means nobody thinks to look for you there, savvy? So what're you waiting for?

items.title: Hacker Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hacker Mansion is a map with the most powerful tools in Minecraft. Explore this luxury mansion to survive as an overpowered legend. Find all the different weapons and tools stashed in chests around the building. Hack your way to victory in Hacker Mansion!

- Millionaire mansion
- Overpowered armor and weapons
- Unique items!

items.title: Glitch Parkour
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
!#$^@ map desc$!%2 Witness AMAZING effects you've never seen before in Minecraft! Climb, roll, and dive your way through challenging parkour levels in your quest to destroy an evil AI. Use your brand new move set and your trusty magnet to fly through the air in spectacular ways!
* New moves and abilities!
* Troll effects simulating your device breaking!
- SINGLEPLAYER ONLY
items.changelog:
! Failing and being sent to the beginning of the level will now reset the timer so you don't have to keep going back to the lobby to get a perfect beginning.
! Fixed levels 3 and 4 sometimes setting best time to 00:00:00 on the first playthrough

items.title: City Living 2
items.creator: Noxcrew
items.description:
With careers to earn cash and mini-games to play, this is no ordinary city map! Try any of the 9 jobs available, and use your hard earned money to buy food and furniture to fill your new home.

+1500 furniture options and textures
+Work as a chef, firefighter, pilot and more
+Adorable pets and flashy cars
+Play with friends in Creative or Survival

! Created by Noxcrew

items.title: Sky Base: Hacker Tools
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Sky Base: Hacker Tools is perfect for anyone who wants to be the most overpowered hacker in the world! This world includes an epic sky base with many hacked weapons, tools, and items. Fly around the galaxy with hacker themed spaceships!

- Hacker weapons and tools
- Sky base world
- Overpowered items
- Spaceships that you can fly with

items.title: Castle
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Castle is perfect for roleplay or survival! Explore and roleplay inside the castle with NPC characters that are walking around.

items.title: Hacker Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Hacker Mansion gives you hacker tools, items, weapons and a mansion base. You can use these hacker tools in survival in single player or multiplayer. It is up to you how you play!

- Hacker tools
- Secret mansion world
- Chests full of item hacks
- Great for single player or multiplayer action
- Works well with survival or roleplay

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Modern Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Mansions are perfect for survival or roleplaying. Enjoy the Modern Mansion world that includes a giant house to live in and epic cars! Live like a rich millionaire!

- Modern mansion world
- Perfect for roleplaying or survival
- Single player or multiplayer
- Includes cars

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Fairytale
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Do you believe in fairytales? Stories that take you beyond reality, to a place that doesn't exist?
Meet all your heroes from the most beautiful fairytales! Cute teens and magical vibes that make you happy, what more do you want?

- 13 adorable skins
- 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Chibi Ninjas
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Who's a cute lil' ninja? You are! Or at least you will be with this pack!

*12 Chibi Ninjas
*2 skins free

items.title: Anime Drip
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Wanna look like a cool anime character?

*12 anime skins
*2 skins free
